newsitem.title: USA: North American March loan fundings down.
newsitem.headline: North American March loan fundings down.

text.p: North American Mortgage Co said Monday that its March 1997 loan fundings were $758 million, compared with February 1997 fundings of $607 million and March 1996 fundings of $853 million.
In addition, the company said, March 1997 loan applications were $1.4 billion, compared with $1.2 billion in February 1997 and $1.6 billion in March 1996.
The March 1997 totals for loan applications and fundings include the results of the company's subprime lending program.
Refinancings represented 36 percent of total fundings and 32 percent of total applications for March 1997, the company said.
